lines.text: In the house of the LORD, Hananiah said God had broken Babylon's yoke and would restore the exiles within two years.
Jeremiah said "Amen," then told Hananiah that a prophet of peace is recognized as sent only if his word comes true.
Hananiah took the yoke off Jeremiah's neck and burned it, saying God would break Babylon's yoke within two years.
The LORD told Jeremiah that Hananiah had broken a yoke of wood but made a yoke of bronze in its place.
Jeremiah told Hananiah he would die that year, and Hananiah died in the seventh month.
